changes.status: research prototype (ADR-007, ADR-010, ADR-011, ADR-012, ADR-013)

fusion.frozen_embedding: the encoder feature (9216 values) standardised with head.npz feature_mean / feature_std, then L2-normalised
fusion.embedding: concatenation of the 128-value head embedding and the 9216-value frozen embedding
fusion.score: z(log d_head) + z(log d_frozen), each d the cosine distance to the nearest baseline and each z standardised by the mean and population std of that part's baseline leave-one-out log distances; reported as exp(z-sum) so the threshold rule applies unchanged

limitations: Validated only on lab bearings and gearboxes with induced faults (MIMII DG, DCASE 2022, MIMII DUE); other machines are out of scope.

Gearbox: on a fresh recording setup (MIMII DUE evaluation data) with 10 baselines it ranked anomalies at AUC 0.67 and caught about 26% of anomalies in single 10 s clips at about 9% false alarms; 60 s recordings caught about 42% (EXP-022, EXP-026).

Bearing: scored with a fusion of two embeddings, AUC 0.70 vs 0.67 before on held-out DCASE 2022 bearing data; 60 s recordings caught about 43% at about 9% false alarms (EXP-028, EXP-029). That bearing set had been used before, and no untouched bearing test exists.
Most anomalies in a single 10 s clip are missed. Recording 60 s per check and 30 baselines catches more (EXP-017, EXP-026).
Below threshold does not mean healthy.
